Question: At a certain beach if it is at least \(80^{\circ} F\) and sunny, then the beach will be crowded. On June \(10\) the beach was not crowded. What can be concluded about the weather conditions on June \(10?\)

Choices.A:
The temperature was cooler than \( 80^{\circ} \)F and it was
not sunny.
Choices.B:
The temperature was cooler than \( 80^{\circ}
\)F or it was not sunny.
Choices.C:
If the temperature was at least \( 80^{\circ}\) F, then it was
sunny.
Choices.D:
If the temperature was cooler than \( 80^{\circ}\) F, then it
was sunny.
Choices.E:
If the temperature was cooler than \( 80^{\circ} \)F, then it
was not sunny.
